subject: VoxCPM2, XTTS-v2, Piper hu-HU, Qwen3-TTS and MMS Hungarian disposition under the provider-neutral FA3 Voice Fabric
mandatory_policy: FA3-VOICE-001 remains provider-neutral and all existing authority boundaries remain unchanged.
A hu-HU request must never be silently routed to a provider without admitted Hungarian support.
XTTS-v2 is the primary Hungarian cloning candidate but is not mandatory to install and cannot be promoted without current-host plus hu-HU quality evidence.
Piper provides the lightweight Hungarian CPU fallback capability; it cannot satisfy cloning requests.
VoxCPM2 is an advanced provider candidate for its officially supported languages, Voice Design, cloning, streaming and native 48 kHz output; Hungarian routing is denied.
Code, runtime, model, voice/dataset and output rights are independently admitted.
Human voice use requires explicit purpose-scoped, non-expired and non-revoked consent plus reference hash lineage.
Provider runtimes remain isolated from ComfyUI and other application environments.
Provider-native masters are preserved; 48 kHz PCM media outputs are derived artifacts with resampling lineage.
Current-host provider PASS and Hungarian quality PASS cannot be fabricated by canonical documents or CI reference tests.
